<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/checkout_sessions/{id}/revoke"}
#docs
Kills the link immediately: the session token stops resolving, so EVERY /checkout/v1/* route answers 401 — including the readable ones — whether or not the buyer had already opened the page. A hosted checkout link is public by construction (minted, then mailed or forwarded), so waiting out its TTL is not a remedy. Independent of the session's lifecycle status: a `completed` session is revocable on purpose, and revoking it also ends the idempotent replay that /checkout/v1/complete would otherwise still serve. Idempotent — revoking twice reports the same `revoked_at` rather than moving it. 404 for an id that is not this business's session.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | cosess_… checkout session public id |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `checkout_session`. One of `checkout_session`. |
| `id` | `string` | The checkout session id. |
| `status` | `string` | The session state. |
| `revoked_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the session was revoked. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Checkout session (id, status, revoked_at) |
| `404` | No such checkout session |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/checkout_sessions/cosess_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/revoke" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)"
```
